standard-dialogue-before-dragon-slayer-i.npc: I'm Jardric. Former boatman and now a researcher for Keldagrim. I'm here with the Varrock Museum to explore this island and discover its secrets.

standard-dialogue-before-dragon-slayer-i.player: From boatman to researcher? That's quite the change.

standard-dialogue-before-dragon-slayer-i.npc: Aye that it is. I do miss it sometimes, but I get so many opportunities now that I never used to. Just look at us! We may well be the first to step foot on this island in centuries.
If that isn't exciting, I don't know what is.

standard-dialogue-after-dragon-slayer-ii.npc: Hello. Wanting to go to Lithkren?

steps.text: You board the boat and travel to Lithkren.

steps.npc: Not too bad. I've been working with the museum to investigate the dragonkin. After what happened they now consider me an expert.
Don't worry though. I've still got enough time to look after this boat for you.

standard-dialogue-after-dragon-slayer-ii.text: You board the boat and travel to Lithkren.
